paragraphs: Pani Energy is a global software company focused on utility and industrial water and wastewater operations intelligence. Its offering is described as one platform holding a complete intelligence toolbox for a plant. An agent called Agent Zed is described as an AI process engineer that does analysis, answers questions, and performs recurring jobs.

The software works with SCADA data, spreadsheets, paper logs, and plant documents, and can ingest data from a system like Hach WIMS. The company says its team supports operators across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Applications are grouped by plant type: wastewater, drinking water, industrial, food and beverage, desalination, and reuse.

The case studies page describes real deployments and what each plant needed, what Pani did, and what it was worth. Entries include a 280 MLD municipal wastewater plant in Washington State and a county water treatment plant in Washington State. Other entries name a beverage bottling plant in Asia and a groundwater replenishment system in California.
